title: Photo: Western Wall and the Dome of the Rock, Jerusalem
summary: Photograph of Jerusalem's Western Wall with the golden Dome of the Rock rising above it and people gathered in the plaza below. No text on the slide.

pictures.description: Photo of the Western Wall in Jerusalem: a long wall of large stone blocks with a crowd of people at its base in the plaza. Above it, the gold-domed Dome of the Rock with blue tile walls, cypress trees, a white minaret on the left and a blue sky with light clouds.
